subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should maintainers split the remaining work into a heartbeat wake precedence bugfix first, or also change Telegram DMs away from the documented default main-session behavior?
rationale: The heartbeat precedence path is a concrete bug, while changing default Telegram DM routing can break users relying on the documented shared-main-session behavior or explicit `session.dmScope: "main"`.

options.title: Split heartbeat precedence first
options.body: Fix or adopt the heartbeat wake routing path so explicit `heartbeat.session` wins, while leaving Telegram default DM behavior controlled by `session.dmScope` until a separate decision.

options.title: Bundle Telegram DM isolation
options.body: Change Telegram DMs to isolate by default as part of this item, accepting the compatibility and documentation impact for users relying on main-session continuity.

options.title: Defer to heartbeat entries
options.body: Hold this behind native per-session heartbeat scheduling, which may be cleaner long term but leaves the current forced-session contamination path unresolved longer.

recommendation.title: Split heartbeat precedence first
recommendation.body: Fix or adopt the heartbeat wake routing path so explicit `heartbeat.session` wins, while leaving Telegram default DM behavior controlled by `session.dmScope` until a separate decision.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent heartbeat/session routing work and the compatibility-sensitive default-routing decision make this the best available owner from the history signals.
